sentences.text:
This is third application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail to applicant who is in custody since 5.7.2023 relating to FIR No.245/2022,
registered at Police Station-Kirnapur, District-Balaghat (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)
(n), 506/34, 367-D of IPC and Sections 3(2)(v), 3(2)(w), 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. There is no change in circumstances than the one taken on earlier occasion.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This is third application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail to applicant who is in custody since 5.7.2023 relating to FIR No.245/2022,
registered at Police Station-Kirnapur, District-Balaghat (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)
(n), 506/34, 367-D of IPC and Sections 3(2)(v), 3(2)(w), 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. There is no change in circumstances than the one taken on earlier occasion.
Repeat bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
4. Trial court is directed to expedite the trial and complete the same within period of six months.
5. If trial is not completed within aforesaid period, then applicant is at liberty to file repeat bail application.
